The '''Viper 2 Grenade Launcher''' was an upgraded version of the original [[Viper grenade launcher]]. A favorite among [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], the primary difference compared to the older model was the Viper 2's much larger magazine. It could fire a variety of grenades.<ref name="ROE" />
